Image: Instagram@/starmusicph Rising Filipino powerhouse vocalist Carmelle Collado is gearing up for the biggest stage of her career as she prepares to compete in the Eurovision Song Contest Asia 2026 Grand Final, which is the inaugural regional spin-off of the famous song competition, which will take place in Bangkok, Thailand, on Saturday, Nov. 14. The Tawag ng Tanghalan alumna expressed immense pride over the prospect of waving the Philippine flag at the event as she shared that she is pouring everything into her vocal preparation.
